# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a strict disciplinarian who acts in a solemn manner when chastising pupils, though he shows obvious favoritism toward older students like Prissy Andrews. He can be insensitive to new students by publicly mortifying them over poor schoolwork, and he lacks strict order in his classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_

## Traits

- Solemn and stern toward young pupils  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- Lax with overall classroom discipline  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)</sub>
- Shows favoritism toward older scholars  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaches Latin and higher academic subjects to scholars preparing for Queen's  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster in Avonlea. On Anne Shirley's first day, he mortified her by displaying her marked-up spelling slate to the entire class. Later, he punished Anne for displaying a vindictive temper by forcing her to stand on the platform by the blackboard. He frequently spent classroom time giving Latin lessons to older students like Prissy Andrews and gave all the Mayflowers he found on a school outing to her. After whipping Sam Boulter for sassing him in class, Mr. Phillips was confronted by Sam's father, who dared him to touch any of his children again.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at Eben Wright's house during school terms  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured his teaching position in Avonlea partly through his uncle being a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
